answer: Rotating Assignment Lottery. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon draws a fresh sonnet of task slots; agents must claim a slot whose hidden nonce matches their key. Only one claim per key per epoch, and slot proofs expire. A fable of repeated registration fails because each identity needs a fresh matching nonce before the beacon reveals it. The attacker pays compute to grind keys, plus a locked oasis of idle capacity awaiting matches, per identity.
